decision_conditions: Condition : 0 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
(Reason.  To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission)

Condition : 3 - Reason for Approval

It is considered that the proposed gates and fencing, because of their position, design and appearance, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of Popham Close and would not be detrimental to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties. On balance, the development is in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.1.9 (Safety and Security) and T.4.4 (Road Safety) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003.
description: Erection of steel gates and fencing to part of southern boundary.
